# Vendored libraries

Self-hosted copies of the libraries used by the landing page (`index.html`). They're unmodified minified builds, loaded with `defer`, with no CDN involved.

| File | Library | Version | Licence |
|------|---------|---------|---------|
| `gsap.min.js` | GSAP core | 3.15.1 | GSAP Standard "No Charge" License, <https://gsap.com/standard-license> (free, including commercial use). The licence header is kept in the file. |
| `ScrollTrigger.min.js` | GSAP ScrollTrigger plugin | 3.15.1 | Same GSAP Standard License as above. |
| `lenis.min.js` | Lenis smooth scroll (darkroom.engineering) | 1.3.27 | MIT, see `LICENSE-lenis.txt`. |

The fonts in `assets/fonts/` have their own licence files (`LICENSE-Geist.txt`, `LICENSE-GeistMono.txt`, `LICENSE-InstrumentSerif.txt`; all SIL Open Font License 1.1).
